environment_spec.actor_inputs: measured observation history and actual HTB path capacities only; no seed/scenario/index
environment_spec.background_policy: actual FRR OSPF h2->h4 and return; no pinning in either mode
environment_spec.capacity_observation: path_capacity_mbps from verified HTB rate/ceil; utilization divided by actual shaped capacity
environment_spec.capacity_policy: path0=[2,20], path1=[20,2], low=[20,20] Mbps; both directions on both inter-router links
environment_spec.counter_interval: per-interface before load through receiver drain and readback
environment_spec.demand_policy: seeded foreground uniform(5.8,6.2), background uniform(1.8,2.2) Mbps; constant per episode
environment_spec.discovery_interval: FRR readiness and all-pairs probes before episode; no SDN discovery
environment_spec.drain_completion: all senders exited; receivers alive; two consecutive complete zero-byte/zero-packet queue sweeps separated by at least drain_poll_interval_seconds; completed within drain_max_seconds
environment_spec.drain_queue_scope: all topology link endpoints, both directions, including hosts and alternate paths; single leaf netem per interface
environment_spec.drain_timeout: truncate with measurement_complete=false; retain final endpoint totals and partial queue evidence; no valid loss/goodput outcome
environment_spec.goodput_denominator: actual foreground sender duration; delivered numerator includes service during control and verified drain
environment_spec.goodput_ratio: received foreground bytes / actual foreground sent bytes
environment_spec.late_received_packets: unavailable (null per flow); workers publish final totals only, no drain-begin streaming counter; never inferred from queue backlog
environment_spec.latency_measurement: foreground ICMP RTT during load; not UDP RTT
environment_spec.name: nanfo-matched-stationary-routing
environment_spec.observability: stationary exogenous capacities and demands observed; sampled queues/history not a proven Markov state
environment_spec.ospf_cost_policy: nominal manifest bandwidth costs frozen before impairment; single next hop prefers dist1; not capacity-aware OSPF
environment_spec.phase_relationship: episode capacities and demands fixed before reset through all decisions
environment_spec.ping_interval: foreground concurrent load through sender termination
environment_spec.queue_interval: post-control load; peak sampled leaf netem; 80ms plus collection time
environment_spec.route_policy: matched overrides exact h1/h3 source+destination /32 both directions at every router on route0/1; ospf ignores action
environment_spec.service_outage: valid positive probe count with zero replies; RTT null; UDP counters still required
environment_spec.state_reward_interval: same returned aggregate; not a separate next-phase measurement
environment_spec.udp_interval: each sender lifetime including control; receiver totals include drain
